title: docs(skills): objectstack-ai no longer teaches an authored AI button on a record page

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：对外发布的 AI 技能文档不再教作者在记录页自己放 AI 按钮，换成一句话：用页头的「问 AI」入口，它自动带上当前记录。应用的使用者无感。界面技能里动作类型表的那一行这次没动，要等类型本身撤掉才能删。
- 为什么做：「问 AI 入口改造」专题已定全站只留一个入口，「页面里加按钮」的需求作废。
- 出错会怎样：只改了文档和一条评测样例；写错的话，用这份技能的 AI 作者会答错怎么加 AI 按钮，撤回本 PR 即可恢复。
- 要你做什么：批准这个受管 PR。它先合，撤掉该动作类型的 PR（#37924，撤类型本身）后合，两者同一个版本发出。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`: the subsection *The Ask AI button* under *Actions as AI Tools* leaves, with its `os:check` `defineAction` example (25 lines). One sentence stands in its place (3 lines):
  > **No page declares an AI button of its own**, so there is no action to write for one: the shell's 「问 AI」 entry opens the in-app assistant and carries the current record automatically.
- `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`: case 10 keeps its id and its prompt (an Ask AI button on the contract record page) and now expects the opposite answer: no action is written, and the answer names the shell's 「问 AI」 entry. `must_contain` is `问 AI`; `must_not_contain` is `defineAction(` and `locations:`.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the row of `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` follows the measurement down, 6799 to 6617. The gate asks for this in the PR that shrinks the file ("Lower the row to 6617 in this PR").
- `.changeset/37857-skill-no-authored-ai-button.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch. `skills/**` ships as that package's `dist`.

**Not in this pull request, and why the first line says `Part of`.** `git grep -n ask_ai -- skills/` still prints two lines, both in `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` (151, the table row; 153, the sentence under the table). They cannot leave before the type does: `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness` holds the *Action Types* table row for row to the members of `ActionType`, and on `main` the member is still there. Measured on this branch with the row deleted:

> [leg2-missing-row] skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md — ### Action Types is registered exhaustive over `ActionType` (packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts) and does not document `ask_ai`.

The gate's other remedy, a gap entry in its ledger, is marked maintainer-only, so it was not taken. The two lines are restored here byte for byte, and the card stays open for them. The seat decides who deletes them: #37924 itself, where the member leaves, or a second small pull request on this card after #37924 merges.

## Why

ADR-0160, seventh amendment (2026-11-27), D6 "Entry point": "the shell's 「问 AI」 button, and no other. Its text is the same in every application, and no application renames it. No page declares an AI button of its own". The maintainer's rulings behind it, as the ADR quotes them: 「"页面里加按钮"的需求 作废」 and 「撤掉 ask_ai(#37834 方案 B)」. The card asks for the teaching to leave the published skills and, where a sentence is needed, for one that says the shell's 「问 AI」 entry carries the current record automatically. The replacement sentence says that and nothing about the parse: what a legacy action meets is #37924's to build and to word.

## Landing order

This pull request lands **before** #37924 (the pull request that retires the action type); both ship in the same release. Reason, measured by the card thread on #37924's head `ca52b5be`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` is red there with one error, `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:188:3 TS2322`, the `os:check` example this pull request deletes, which no longer type-checks once `ActionType` loses the member. With this merged first, that example is gone from `main` before #37924 needs it gone.

Between the two merges `main` holds a skill that says no page declares an AI button while the type still parses, and the `objectstack-ui` table still lists it. Both ship together, so no published version carries that state.

## Acceptance notes

- **Acceptance is met in part.** "`git grep -n ask_ai -- skills/` is empty" is not reachable in a pull request that lands before the type leaves; two lines remain, as said above. "Skill checks pass" holds on this head.
- **File surface.** The claim names `skills/**` only. Two files outside it are in the diff, each forced by a gate the card orders green: the ratchet row (one number and a three-line comment in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) and the changeset. Neither path is under `packages/**` or `docs/adr/**`.
- **Why case 10 is kept and turned, not deleted.** The prompt is the request the maintainer voided, and it is the one an assistant will keep receiving; the case now measures whether the sentence above stops an authored action. The eval reader takes ids as given and asks only that they are unique in a file, so 11 and 12 keep their numbers. A `must_not_contain` on the type's literal name was not available (the card's grep forbids it under `skills/`); `defineAction(` and `locations:` are tokens only an authored action carries, and the reference answer spells neither.
- **The entry's name.** The sentence and the eval use 「问 AI」, as the ADR and the card do. The console's English bundle labels the entry `Ask AI` today (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`, `askAI`). Noted, not acted on: where the button is drawn and what it reads in each locale is #37858's.
- **`objectstack-ui` gets no sentence here.** A line saying no page declares an AI button would sit under a table row that teaches the type. It belongs with the deletion of that row.
- **Claim.** The seat's `Claim:` comment on #37857 is 7217200370, naming this branch. (The drafter read the card before it landed and saw zero comments; the work ran on the dispatch order's claim block, which is the same text.)

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the hunk at line 174: the replacement sentence is published text. Check it says no more than ADR-0160 D6 and nothing #37924 has yet to build.
2. `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`, case 10: the two assertion lists.
3. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: one row, 6799 to 6617, lowered only.

Two-minute verification: `git grep -n ask_ai -- skills/` prints exactly two lines, both in `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` (151 and 153), and `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` ends with its ✓ line.

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the maintainer summary is Chinese by the fleet's rule; quoted rulings are kept as written)
